abstract.p: Training models that can perform well on various NLP tasks requires large amounts of data, which becomes even more apparent with more nuanced tasks such as anaphora and coreference resolution. This paper presents the automatic creation of an Arabic CorefUD dataset through the automatic conversion of the existing gold-annotated OntoNotes.
